Recover.Result: **Bad advice, followed.** A med-terminal talked the nurse through it, step by confident step. The patient is **Laid up**, even if the test succeeded, and the nurse is very sorry
**Caught it.** Whatever the patient had, the nurse has it now: the nurse is **Sore**
**Billed by the bed.** The clinic charges by the hour, rounded up to the week: lose **3 parts**
**Paste, three times a day.** The nurse insists, for the patient's own good. The patient starts the next battle **Shook**, and furious

**"You're healing SO well!"** Chet Jippity says it every hour, and the patient believes it. The player may have them play the next battle even if they are still Laid up, with **Bad stitches** (section 13.2)
**Gossip in the ward.** The next bed knows everyone: gain the contact **Informer**
**Re-taped.** The nurse re-tapes the patient's armour while they sleep: the patient starts the next battle **Under warranty**
**Visitors bring scrap,** and stay for the paste: **+3 parts**
**Fitted while asleep.** If the patient needs a prosthetic, a copy one is fitted free, and they wake up with it
**Ward rounds.** The nurse makes them for everyone: every **Laid up** fighter of the crew is only **Sore**
**Right, for once.** The med-assistant is right: one **lasting injury** of the patient is gone (the title stays)

Scavenge.Result: **The wreck shifts.** The fighter is **Laid up**, and the find stays under it: no pay from the test
**Someone else's claim.** A gang's marker on the wreck. Hand over **3 parts**, or keep everything and write the gang as a **rival**

**Terms and conditions.** The wreck's voice wakes and reads them out, all of them. Agree, and the fighter starts the next battle **Under warranty** and **Announced** (the voice read their name out to everyone); refuse, and the voice locks the wreck: the task pays only its failure pay
**A salvage permit.** An Inspectorate patrol checks. Pay **3 parts**, or forge one with a **Tricky (8)** Tech test: success, pay nothing; failure, pay **6**
**A dead bot, still polite.** It thanks the fighter for visiting. Its core is gone, but it asks to be remembered, and the fighter remembers: **+1 XP** (it knew a great deal about wrecks)
**A flat cell,** not quite flat. Recharge one fighter's battery by 2, free, this break
**A copy item** worth up to 5 parts, under a lot of tape
**Samples.** A Control Group bot buys scrap nobody wants and leaves a card: **+4 parts**, or gain the contact **Informer** instead
**Somebody's camp,** abandoned in a hurry: a copy item worth up to 8 parts, and a **lead**
**A live charging point.** Every battery in the crew refills free this break
**A working power cell,** the rare kind: **+15 parts**, or keep it as a spare cell

Work a job.Result: **The job was a fight,** and the target was the fighter. They are **Laid up**, and nobody pays
**The fine print.** Jeminy drafted the contract, and it had a clause. Pay back **4 parts** (never below 0), or refuse: tear up the contract, write the patron as a **rival**, and gain **Oathbreakers**
**One star.** The Per-Diem platform rates the fighter's work, badly, and every patron can read it: the fighter starts the next battle **Flustered** (they have seen the comments)
**A collection job.** The debtor was a friend. Squeeze them for **+3 parts** and gain **Butchers**, or let them off and gain **Merciful**
**Paid in vegetables,** very nutritious. Half the pay (rounded down) is vegetables, which are not parts, but the fighter starts the next battle **Hyped**
**Overtime.** The job ran long, and the patron noticed who stayed: gain the contact **Patron**
**A uniform.** The Inspectorate hires the fighter for a day and lets them keep the hat. They may take the title "Deputy", and the crew pays no Inspectorate fee or fine this break
**Switched sides.** The patron's rival offers more. Take **+5 parts** and write the first patron as a **rival**, or stay loyal and gain **Oathkeepers**
**Paid in kit:** a copy weapon or armour worth up to 8 parts
**More work.** The patron wants the crew again: one other fighter who has not taken their task yet may Work a job this break at **Routine (6)**
**The patron dies,** rich and without heirs: **+15 parts**

Hunt leads.Result: **Dead, says the board.** Gawk's rumour board says the fighter died, and the crew believed it. One of the fighter's items, the player's choice, was already sold: gain half its price in parts
**Wrong bar.** Someone remembers an unpaid boast. Buy the room a round (**3 parts**) and gain **Oathkeepers**, or gain **Oathbreakers**
**"The server is busy."** The fighter waited all break for Dipstick: no finds roll, even if the test succeeded
**A confession.** A Waiting priest took the fighter's questions as one: lose **2 parts** in donations
**A long story** about a pod, from a drifter. It was a film, but the crew likes it: gain a **lead**
**A drifter wants in.** One recruit may be hired this break for **5 parts less**
**A useful name.** Gain one contact of the player's choice
**A buried pod,** unlooted: roll on the **finds** table twice and keep one
**A song about the fighter.** **+1 XP**, and a drifter pays **2 parts** to sing it
**The truth about something.** The player writes one true thing about the world on the roster (no rule; the story keeps it), and the fighter gains **+2 XP**

Train.Result: **A live round** in the practice gun. The trainee is **Laid up**
**A paid course.** It was a film about training: lose **3 parts**
**Overconfident.** The trainee picks a Word for the next battle now (any tier) and writes it on their card
**Drills to Chet Jippity,** who calls every rep "incredible". The trainee believes it, and starts the next battle **Hyped**
**Practised falling.** The trainee starts the next battle **Under warranty**
**A montage.** Hollowood filmed it: **+3 parts**, and the crew gains **Showboats**
**Found their style.** The trainee may swap one advance for another they qualify for
**An odd teacher.** The trainee may swap one advance for one from any list, even one they have no rating in
**The teacher's secret.** The trainee may swap one advance for the teacher's best trick: any trait the teacher has (not a Legend or captain trait)
